description: Short-distance variant of the watchdog case (team decision 2026-11-24): the plan's pre-search ETA estimate is 1799 s (29:59) -> distance_class short. Comparison budget = plan start 0 + 3000; watchdog = start 1000 + 5000 (counted from the native call start). At 6000 Rust detects engine_stuck from now_mono_ms; the slot stays occupied (a reroute request only sends cancel, no start) until r1's search_finished, then r2 starts with the plan's short class. 'expect_starts' lists the start{req_id, priority, distance_class} each step must emit: distance_class short on both starts.
